_doc: Conditions. modifiers follow src/rules/mods.gd. flags are read by the encounter engine: skipTurn (cannot act), helpless (attackers get +4, sneak attack applies), wakeOnDamage (removed when damaged), noMove (cannot move), singleAction (move OR standard action each turn).

shaken.name: Shaken
shaken.desc: -2 on attack rolls, saves and skill checks.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.desc: Too afraid to act; -2 on attacks, saves and skills.

sickened.name: Sickened
sickened.desc: -2 on attack rolls, damage, saves and skill checks.

prone.name: Prone
prone.desc: -4 on melee attacks; -4 AC against melee, +4 AC against ranged.

entangled.name: Entangled
entangled.desc: -2 on attack rolls, -4 Dexterity, cannot move.

staggered.name: Staggered
staggered.desc: Only a single move or standard action each turn.

defending.name: Total Defense
defending.desc: +4 dodge bonus to AC until your next turn.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.desc: -2 AC, -4 on most Strength and Dexterity skill checks, attacks suffer.
